name: Amla-Pitta
subtitle: Amla & Neem Clarifying Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: An clarifying, scalp-cooling antidote to heat and irritation, inspired by traditional Ayurvedic recipes. Amla-Pitta harnesses the astringent prowess of Neem and the revitalizing richness of Amla to clarify the scalp while soothing fiery, itchy discomfort. Blended with cooling Camphor and a hydrating Coconut oil base, this lightweight formula gently breaks down sebum and flakiness without stripping away essential moisture.

ingredients.name: Amla Fruit
ingredients.role: Rich in antioxidants to refresh and nourish follicles

ingredients.name: Neem Leaves
ingredients.role: Deeply purifying and antimicrobial to target dandruff and irritation

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.role: Lightweight base that moisturizes and cools the scalp

ingredients.name: Camphor Crystals
ingredients.role: Provides instant cooling relief and alleviates itching

whyThisHerb: Neem, revered for centuries as a natural purifier, joins forces with cooling Camphor to pacify an irritated, dandruff-prone scalp while restoring lasting, light-weight balance.

howToUse.title: Section & Apply
howToUse.description: Divide your hair into sections to reveal the scalp. Pour a few drops of the clarifying oil directly onto the parted lines.

howToUse.title: Scalp Massage
howToUse.description: Using your fingertips, gently massage the oil into your scalp for 5 to 10 minutes, focusing on areas with irritation or buildup.

howToUse.title: Allow to Clarify
howToUse.description: Leave on for 30 to 45 minutes to let the neem and camphor cleanse and soothe.

howToUse.title: Rinse & Purify
howToUse.description: Wash thoroughly with a gentle clarifying shampoo. Use twice a week to maintain a fresh, balanced scalp.
